online: No online trophies. No difficulty trophies. No mission medals.

phases.text: Play the story in order and make a manual save at the start of every chapter. Meditate at Lucia's balcony before Chapter 1 ends — it is the one spot that never comes back. Keep a save from just before the final mission, because there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus.
phases.title: Story + save every chapter

phases.text: Finish any 8 stranger mission strands for the silver, starting with the five that carry their own trophies (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone). Try each activity type once, win a drone race at every location, beat Cal at fishing, finish an arcade game, and play a full game of bowling.
phases.title: Strangers, side missions, activities

phases.text: Sweep the map district by district: complete 3 card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, discover 100 vehicles, register 10 of them to the Scooter Bros app, explore all 52 areas, and meditate at the remaining spots. Try the unconfirmed trophies' candidate approaches as you pass their locations.
phases.title: Collectibles + whole map

phases.text: Plan every escape before you strike: lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back, rob 5 bank vaults and an armored truck, hit one illegal operation per gang, and launder $250,000 in marked bills. Buy garage properties as you can afford them.
phases.title: Crime + money

phases.text: Counters first, then range golds, then the 100% checklist: 250 stunts, gold medals in all 42 shooting range challenges, wins in 20 different races. When A Long Road (100%) pops, the platinum pops with it.
phases.title: Grind + cleanup

title: Roadmap to Platinum
